text:
Sophie: FYI opening mirror window for private delta sync tomorrow 02:00-04:00 UTC. Need final decisions on mirror priority + rollback triggers.
Anil: 👍 Packaging will push delta-first flow. Can we pin delta artifact versions in the staging manifest so transport doesn't pick full image when bandwidth constrained?
Maria: +1 pinning is safer. We'll write a small manifest shim that prefers delta tag then falls back to full if delta fails verification.
Tal: What are the checksum/size mismatch thresholds for abort vs retry? We should avoid partial mirror that hangs the offline installer.
Ops Lead: Proposal: if checksum mismatch OR unpack failure => automatic abort and rollback to previous sealed manifest. If >3 transient network retries, escalate but keep in aborted state.
Sophie: Sounds good. Also need KMS signoff — @Anil can you confirm signer key not rotating during window?
Anil: Confirmed, KMS rotation paused for the window. Signing queue will use signer:v2 key. PackagingBot will attach cosign sig.
PackagingBot: deploy-bot: manifest prepared at s3://release-staging/deltas/3135794201/manifest.json
PackagingBot: cosign: signed by signer:v2
Maria: Quick manifest snippet to share with transport team:
```
priority: ["delta", "full"]
delta_tag: "v1.12.3-delta-2026-03"
fallback_policy: "full-on-mismatch"
max_retries: 3
```
Tal: If a delta fails and full fallback is used we need to track metric: delta_success_rate and fallback_count per site. Plan to add a Prometheus label in transport.
Sophie: Agree. Ops Lead – make sure canary seed (5% of customers) are marked in the rollout so we can watch errors before global cutover.
Ops Lead: Canary seeds set. Cutover schedule: canary @02:10 UTC, evaluate for 20m. Full roll at 02:35 if canary OK. Rollback window until 03:00.
Deploy-bot: scheduled: mirror-job 3135794201 created; canary=5%; window=02:00-04:00 UTC; notify=#incidents on failure
Anil: Note: if any signer mismatch or cosign verification fails, auto-abort and create hotfix branch for repackaging.
Maria: I'll prep the release notes snippet and include delta fallback semantics + cosign hash in the manifest.
Sophie: Thanks everyone. Last call for objections — otherwise we'll lock the manifest and freeze staging artifacts at 01:30 UTC.
Tal: No objections from infra. Will monitor unpack & verifier logs.
Sophie: Locking plan at 01:30 UTC. I'll post the final signed manifest after locking.
PackagingBot: final-manifest: s3://release-staging/deltas/3135794201/manifest.final.json
Deploy-bot: NOTICE: mirror-job 3135794201 queued. Monitoring hooks attached.
Sophie: ok merging into release calendar. :party_parrot:
